scope: Homogeneous field-free two-ion Julia velocity-space benchmark; not a spatial separator or Marathon model.
limitations: Selecting a case or saved time does not run a solver or change physical inputs.
These coarse finite representations fail physical-rate and distribution qualification.
Named drift and anisotropy cases retain unequal 2/10 eV thermal energies; they are not isolated single-effect controls.
No fields, spatial transport, electrons, device walls, fusion reactions or target stopping are modeled.
No physical entropy is included; finite-rule entropy decay does not prove physical-H monotonicity.
Recorded moments do not resolve a full velocity distribution or establish its accuracy.
Source paths identify locally retained immutable files; complete source archives are not included in this public packet.

units.temperatureTensorDefinition: m_s times covariance about each species mean, including fixed Gaussian variance; expressed as k_B T in eV
